text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I hear
some
students' voices.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What the heck's going on here?! This
stuff's
totally in our way!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they were used for an event? But
there are
so many of them...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see a huge pile of boxes stacked in
front of
them. It looks like the boxes are
blocking the
way.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Dang it! If we don't do something about
this we'll
be late for class!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm going to blow them away with
magic!
Here goes nothing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Raging torrent, wash away all in our way!

Chrysanthemum ☆ Splash!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Sparkles from the heavens, drive away
all in our
sight! Oxypetalum ☆ Blue Star!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey, nothing's happening!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: B-be quiet! I just need to warm up is all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right, it's time for a hero to step up! It's time for me to step up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait! I'm not ready to step down!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to work up to this, but it looks
like I've
got no choice. Here comes my
ultimate
incantation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho waves her wand. I have a
feeling
things are about to get
magical—no, physical!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! This is the magic my
granny
always used to cast when she got
into a fight with
my gramps!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ULTIMATE IMPACT!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BOOM! THWUMP! CRASH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may be small, but she packs a
punch! Dozens
of boxes are flattened in
the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Nice job, Sweep! Now we can
waltz on
through!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, everything's a breeze when you've
got a
genius magical girl by your side! ♪
I wanna cast
that magic again...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Crap, look at the time! We've gotta get
to class!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll clean it up later with magic! Come on
you two,
we need to book it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They rush away... I know Sweep Tosho
said she'd
clean it up later, but I'd hate
to leave such a
mess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to clean it up before anyone
else comes
along.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, now let's get back to—huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Everything's been tidied up! I must
have
performed some subconscious
magic!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Just what do you think you're all
doing?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yikes! We've been spotted!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Flower! Biko! We've gotta escape while
we can!
We still have time to outrun her!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tch, they got away. Hey you, do you
know what
happened here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain the situation to Air Groove and

apologize for letting Sweep Tosho
destroy the
boxes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. Looks like you got played by that
naughty
girl.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But that does make you complicit. And
you'll
need to take responsibility for
your actions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I agree to Air Groove's terms and set
about
cleaning diligently by myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear later that Sweep Tosho and the
others were
also given a very stern
lecture.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why are you trying to stop me?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, you're right. There's no telling
what'll
happen when I set it off.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, fine. I'll try a different type of
magic
then. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's time for a command spell!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Cirsium ☆ Oxalis ☆ Iris! I command you
two to
clean up these boxes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Flower, I've folded the cardboard!
What's
next?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Tie them up with string. Here, take this
end of it
and...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, that'd be great! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of us get to work cleaning up
the
boxes. However...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
How come you're all having such a
blast?! You're
being forced to clean up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So it's come to this, has it?! I'm gonna
have to
show you how it's done! Hand
me that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling lonely as she watches us from
the
sidelines, Sweep Tosho ends up
joining in too.
